name: waynestate/pinstripe
description: The coding standard for the Wayne State app stack: shared Pint, PHPStan and Rector presets, and banned calls.

suggest.rector/rector: ^2.8 (apps: use rector/base.php from your rector.php, rector/strict-types.php to declare strict types file by file, and rector/levels.php to climb one rule level at a time)

scripts-descriptions.ci: The full CI contract: validate composer.json, run the PHPUnit suite (Pint and PHPStan against the fixtures), check the agent-ready files, check the docs site, audit dependencies. Same command on GitLab and GitHub.
scripts-descriptions.docs: Build the docs site into site/docs/ from docs/ (Squire's shared builder).
scripts-descriptions.docs:check: Fail when site/docs/ is stale or a docs page has a broken link, block or nav entry.
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready: Rewrite the Markdown twins, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, robots.txt and sitemap.xml in site/ (Squire's agent-ready kit).
scripts-descriptions.site:agent-ready-check: Fail when the agent-ready files are stale, a page lacks its Markdown link, a prompt drifts from the docs, or the kit was edited here.
